about: What this sketch itself asserts, with how sure it is. Confidence: high, medium, low.

assertions.text: The cover is visible from Sentinel-2 at 10 m.
assertions.basis: Scene 2021-08-14: a bright strip along the ski run on snow-free terrain.

assertions.text: Fleece and clean ice differ in shortwave infrared (fleece reflects, ice absorbs).
assertions.basis: Two sample areas per surface, one date: fleece 37-47%, ice 3-4% at 1.6 um.
assertions.limit: Two areas, one date; sheets age and get dirty.

assertions.text: The covered area can be counted year by year from 2016.
assertions.basis: First run gives numbers for every year.
assertions.limit: Not validated: debris and clouds counted as fleece; edges lost at 20 m.

assertions.text: The melt model reproduces the field result of 52-69% less melt.
assertions.limit: Synthetic weather and placeholder albedos for now: gives about 38%.
